# Claimball

> Claimball is a casual duel game for iOS and Android, coming soon. Bounce the ball on a notebook grid, turn tiles into your land, and beat AI rivals in quick matches of about 90 seconds.

Claimball is a casual player-versus-AI mobile game by ipe() (https://ipe.rest/). It is coming soon to iOS and Android and has NOT been released: no store page or release date exists yet. This site is the game's home and its journal. The website collects only basic visit statistics through Google Analytics and has no accounts or ads; the game app itself has no analytics SDK and no accounts. On iOS the app can save game progress to the player's own iCloud to continue on another device; it is not sent to our servers.

## Key facts

- You play against an AI rival on a notebook-style grid of 6 by 10 tiles, trading a ball back and forth.
- The tile where your ball bounces becomes your land; if you miss a return, the other side takes land from you.
- A hit in the center is a smash that claims three tiles at once.
- A match takes about 90 seconds, and the final seconds are a showdown.
- There are 6 AI rivals across 2 leagues at launch, with more planned in updates.
- Free to try. One purchase unlocks everything. No ads, no subscription.

## Journal posts (English)

- [Claimball speaks 13 languages in the test builds](https://claimball.ipe.rest/journal/thirteen-languages/) — 2026-11-08 — From nine languages to thirteen, plus an automatic check that keeps every translation complete.
- [Color-blind patterns: telling tiles apart without relying on color](https://claimball.ipe.rest/journal/color-blind-patterns/) — 2026-11-07 — A setting adds dots on your tiles and stripes on the opponent's, and text contrast was improved in both looks.
- [Claimball can be read aloud with VoiceOver and handles large text](https://claimball.ipe.rest/journal/voiceover-and-large-text/) — 2026-11-06 — Build 14 announces every part of a match with VoiceOver and keeps layouts intact at large text sizes and on small screens.
- [Your first Claimball match now starts with a short guide](https://claimball.ipe.rest/journal/how-to-play-first-match/) — 2026-11-05 — A three-card How to play guide greets you on your first match in the latest test builds.
- [My Stats and background music arrive in Claimball](https://claimball.ipe.rest/journal/my-stats-and-music/) — 2026-11-04 — The latest test build adds a My Stats screen with your wins, draws and losses, and three original music tracks with an on/off toggle.
- [How a tied match ends in Claimball](https://claimball.ipe.rest/journal/sudden-death-and-draws/) — 2026-11-03 — A tie used to end in a confusing result. Here is how sudden death works now, and what changed in the latest test builds.
- [Starting to make Claimball](https://claimball.ipe.rest/journal/starting-claimball/) — 2026-10-31 — The first journal post. What Claimball is, and why this journal exists.

## Languages

The site is available in 13 languages: English, 한국어, 日本語, 简体中文, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, Русский, Tiếng Việt, Français, Deutsch, العربية, हिन्दी. Each language lives under /<code>/ (English at the root).
